title: Canton Food Not Bombs current first-party site
summary: Current Canton Food Not Bombs site documents active weekly food sharing, its Food Not Bombs identity, harm-reduction/material-aid work, and its fiscal sponsorship by Food For Thought.

data.notes: Current first-party site describes Canton Food Not Bombs as an active Canton, Ohio food-sharing organization with weekly gatherings and explicitly states that it is fiscally sponsored by Food For Thought.
